chapters.title: Cloud Computing & AWS Overview
chapters.description: Demystify the cloud! We'll start with what cloud computing really is, why it took over the world, and a high‑level look at Amazon Web Services.

chapters.title: Getting Started with AWS
chapters.description: Create your AWS account, understand the Free Tier, and learn to navigate the Management Console safely.

chapters.title: Identity & Access Management (IAM)
chapters.description: Master users, groups, roles, and policies – the key to securing your AWS kingdom.

chapters.title: Compute Services: EC2
chapters.description: Launch virtual servers in minutes. Understand instance types, AMIs, key pairs, and security groups.

chapters.title: Storage Services: S3 & EBS
chapters.description: Store unlimited data with S3 and attach persistent block storage to EC2 with EBS.

chapters.title: Databases: RDS & DynamoDB
chapters.description: Managed relational databases and lightning‑fast NoSQL – choose the right tool for your data.

chapters.title: Networking: VPC & Subnets
chapters.description: Design your own isolated network in the cloud. Subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways explained.

chapters.title: Serverless & Lambda
chapters.description: Run code without thinking about servers. Dive into AWS Lambda and API Gateway.

chapters.title: Monitoring & Management
chapters.description: Keep an eye on your infrastructure with CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and the AWS CLI.

chapters.title: Security Best Practices
chapters.description: Lock everything down: IAM policies, encryption at rest and in transit, and shared responsibility.

chapters.title: Cost Management & Billing
chapters.description: Don’t let your bill surprise you. Budgets, cost explorer, and Free Tier tricks.

chapters.title: High Availability & Auto Scaling
chapters.description: Build systems that survive disasters. Load balancers, auto scaling groups, and multi‑AZ deployments.
